announcements.title: A Quick Note from the Aniraku Team
announcements.banner: Thank you for your continued love and support for Aniraku.I am here to Listen buddies.
body:
Hey everyone! 👋

Aniraku is still very much a passion project I keep running between real life and coffee, and your support is what keeps the lights on.

We’re getting ready for V5.8.0 and I’d love your honest take: how much would you actually care about proper in-app offline downloads (no external downloader required)? Offline downloads already work on the website, and the app version is actively being built.

While we’re at it… is there any other feature you’d really like to see next? Your feedback genuinely shapes the roadmap.

If you’re on GitHub, a star would make my day (and help the project look a bit less lonely).

Also looking for a couple of kind souls to help grow the community on Discord or Telegram. I’m… let’s just say “not a natural community manager,” so any help setting things up properly would be hugely appreciated.

Quick heads-up: because of a recent PHP security situation we need to close the door on the old version. V5.7.9 will stop working soon, so I’m pushing a Beta of the new update today. Please give it a spin and shoot me an email if you run into anything weird — the faster I hear about it, the faster I can fix it.

I was honestly hoping a few of you would reach out… still waiting 👀

Thanks for sticking with Aniraku. Now go enjoy some anime.

— the guy who still hasn’t slept enough
